name: week
title: Agreement review
subtitle: Fictional demo unless you have imported your own records

sections.title: Delivery shortfalls
sections.sql: select account,agreement,product,ends_on,gap,currency,gap_value,actuals_freshness from delivery_gaps order by ends_on

sections.title: Renewals
sections.sql: select agreement,account,owner,ends_on,days_left from renewals_due order by ends_on

sections.title: Items for review
sections.sql: select rule,record,issue from control_exceptions order by rule,record

sections.title: Planned and actual
sections.sql: select agreement,product,starts_on,ends_on,planned,actual,unit,currency,planned_value,actual_value from schedule_performance where status in ('Active','Approved') order by starts_on
